title: Underlying inverse image for modules from a normalized ring presentation
statement: Let F:C to D be continuous and representably flat between small sites, and assume its set inverse image preserves finite limits. Let phi:A to F_*B be a ring-sheaf morphism [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Suppose a unit presentation identifies the underlying set sheaf of B with the set inverse image of the underlying set sheaf of A and its unit is exactly underlying phi [def-weil-pbc-sheaf-pullback-unit-presentation]. Then the chosen SheafOfModules.pullback(phi), followed by forgetting to abelian sheaves, is naturally isomorphic to forgetting A-modules followed by the constructed abelian inverse image.

source.place: Tag 03D3, lemma-adjoint-push-pull-modules, and Tag 03D2, lemma-pullback-module; prove the omitted converse-linearity argument using the two-variable unit testing criterion.

proof.text: For each A-module, apply the canonical forgetful comparison and its unit equation to its abelian inverse image. This gives an abelian unit presentation. Its product with the given ring presentation tests equality of maps from B times the inverse-image abelian sheaf on pairs (phi(r),eta(m)).

Construct the inverse-image actions from these presentations. For an abelian morphism alpha with a linear adjunct beta, compare alpha after source scalar action and target scalar action after identity times alpha. On unit pairs the source unit scalar equation identifies the first value with beta(r m); the other is phi(r) beta(m). Linearity of beta and the pair testing criterion give equality, so alpha is linear.

Define the lifted inverse-image functor using these objects and the preceding criterion on the abelian image of a module morphism. Naturality and linearity of the unit show the adjunct is linear. Faithfulness of the forgetful functor proves identity and composition. The original abelian inverse-image functor is its underlying functor, with identity component comparisons.

The abelian hom equivalence restricts to module morphisms: a linear alpha has linear adjunct by the linear unit; conversely the previous criterion gives a linear alpha from any linear beta. Apply the existing fully proved generic private helper AlgebraicGeometry.adjunctionOfLinearLifts in Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.EtaleInverseImageModuleAdjunction, made accessible by a proof-only import all. Its category binders are generic; no etale scheme or coefficient hypothesis is used. It packages the restricted hom correspondence as an adjunction to the same scalar-restricted pushforward as Mathlib pullback.

Use leftAdjointUniq to compare Mathlib pullback with the constructed lifted functor and whisker with the abelian forgetful functor. Compose with the identity underlying comparison to obtain the asserted natural isomorphism.

theorem inverseImage_underlying_of_ring_presentation
    [RepresentablyFlat F] [PreservesFiniteLimits (sheafPullback F (Type u) J K)]
    (pr : SheafPullbackUnitPresentation (F := F)
      ((sheafCompose J (CategoryTheory.forget RingCat.{u})).obj A)
      ((sheafCompose K (CategoryTheory.forget RingCat.{u})).obj B))
    (hr : pr.unit = (sheafCompose J (CategoryTheory.forget RingCat.{u})).map φ) :
    Nonempty (pullback.{u} φ ⋙ toSheaf B ≅
      toSheaf A ⋙ sheafPullback F AddCommGrpCat.{u} J K)
